senses.gloss:
भेष् (ऋ) भेषृ r. 1st cl. (भेषति-ते)
 1. To fear or dread.
 2. To go.

भेषज n. (-जं)
 1. A remedy, a drug, a medicament.
 2. A kind of fennel,
(Nigella Indica.)
 E. भेष here interpreted disease, जि to conquer, aff.
ड; or भिषज् a root of a particular class, and अच् aff.

भेषजाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The vehicle or medium in which medicine is adminis-
tered, as water gruel, &c.
 E. भेषज a drug, and अङ्ग a limb or part.
